_comment: Retrieval parameters for corpus v1. top_n is the number of chunks the window holds, and it is the one lever that trades the guarantee against the cost cap: the corpus is written until every gold source of every question is inside the window at this number. rrf_k, recency_weight and max_chunks_per_doc are the pipeline defaults and were not tuned. See README.md, section 'The pipeline and its parameters'.
